quality_notes: Basic and standard are input-first: English→Japanese and Japanese→English only.
Context/cloze/synonym/family modes are restricted to developed and above.
New core entries are sourced from NGSL 1.01 Japanese data, limited to frequency ranks through 2200 and deduplicated against the existing study set.
No proper-name list or specialty trivia is used for these additions.
Basic/Standard headwords are globally deduplicated so the same English word is not presented twice across the two foundation levels.
Standard extra entries extend NGSL Japanese data through rank 2809, excluding duplicates and obvious noisy/non-study entries.

attribution.base_list: New General Service List (NGSL) by Browne, C. and Culligan, B.
